# GSO-RL

> GSO-RL (Guided Strategic Oscillation with Reinforcement Learning) is a metaheuristic framework
> for combinatorial optimization. A memory of guiding solutions (guides), the General Context
> Memory (GCM), maps the search space: each guide represents a region split into concentric rings.
> Each new solution is located by its closest guide and ring, and an independent learning agent per
> ring (Thompson sampling by default, UCB1 in the published version) chooses the next macro-move.
> Rewards are delayed through a sliding window, the Current Context Memory (CCM). Users write one
> C++ adapter: solution + cost, guide generator, dissimilarity, and a set of generic macro-moves.
> Agent, reward and guide selection are configurable; presets reproduce the published
> configuration. Whether learning per region pays off depends on the problem: controls
> (random, fixed macro-move, one global agent, shuffled agents not tied to regions) measure it.

Published in: Siverio-González, Melián-Batista, Moreno-Vega. Expert Systems with Applications 334
(2027) 134651. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2026.134651
